entries.text: A TPC-DS or TPC-DS-OBT scale factor below 0.01 is refused with ScaleFactorOutOfRangeError again (it had become a plain ValueError), and the message now states what was observed: the bundled dsdgen did not finish at SF 0.001.

When BenchBox stops dsqgen at its own 30-second limit, the error now names the query, the scale factor and that the limit is BenchBox's; one path previously reported a 60-second limit that did not exist.
The interactive official-mode prompt offers each benchmark's own TPC scale points; it no longer offers 30 for TPC-DS.
